title: integration: use our own pause image
body:
The registry.k8s.io/pause image contains many tags so sync copies a lot
of unneeded images. Also for some reason this test is hard broken on
container-libs failing to fetch a non existing tag.

So swap this to our own namespace quay.io/libpod/k8s-pause which only
contains two tag with the correct test requirements and we do not have
to worry that it breaks us all of the sudden.

comments.body: updated the copy tests as well
